name: Restaurant Nights
description: Eat at a partner restaurant on its scheduled night and a share of sales goes straight to the PTA — no extra cost to you.
how_to_join: Just show up during the scheduled window below. Some restaurants (like Chick-fil-A) require ordering through their app and selecting the PTA's event at checkout — see the note on that date.

dates.note: Order through the Chick-fil-A app and tap “Support Community Care Event” at checkout.

name: THES Spirit Wear
description: Thunder Hill gear — hoodies, tees, and more — with a portion of every purchase going back to the PTA.
how_to_join: Shop either online store below — no minimum, ships straight to you.

name: PTA Membership
description: The PTA's biggest annual fundraiser — one membership a year funds the programs we run all year long.
how_to_join: Join or renew online — takes less than a minute. No volunteering required.

name: Box Tops for Education
description: Scan your grocery and online purchase receipts in the free Box Tops app — the PTA earns money automatically, at no cost to you.
how_to_join: Download the Box Tops app and link it to Thunder Hill Elementary School PTA.

name: See's Candies Fundraiser
description: Order See's Candies online through the PTA's storefront — 50% of every purchase is donated straight back to the PTA.
how_to_join: Shop the storefront any time of year — great for holidays and gifts.

name: Mabel's Labels
description: Durable, dishwasher- and laundry-safe labels for backpacks, water bottles, and school gear — 20% of your purchase supports the PTA.
how_to_join: Visit campaigns.mabelslabels.com and search for Thunder Hill Elementary School PTA, then purchase — labels ship right to your door.

name: Givebacks Rewards (Shop to Give)
description: Shop online or dine out through the Givebacks app or Chrome extension and earn cashback automatically — families earn about $100 a year on average, and you choose how much of it to donate to the PTA.
how_to_join: Sign up free, add the Chrome extension or app, and link a card for in-store and dining offers — no purchase required to join.

name: RaiseRight Gift Cards
description: Buy everyday gift cards at full value — groceries, gas, takeout, and more — and a percentage comes back to the PTA on every purchase.
how_to_join: Download the RaiseRight app or visit raiseright.com and use the enrollment code below to get started.

name: Make a Donation
description: A one-time or recurring donation, no purchase required — every dollar goes straight to programs, grants, and classroom support.
how_to_join: Give any amount, any time of year.

name: THES SOAR Cart Donations
description: Our Thunderbirds are working hard this year to demonstrate THES's SOAR behaviors! They're earning DOJO points for Showing Kindness, Including Others, Showing Respect to Others, and Being Responsible — and can use those points to shop at the SOAR cart every other week. The SOAR Team is looking for creative ways to keep the cart stocked.
how_to_join: Use the Amazon Wish List below to have an item sent directly to the school.
